The plate is a square side plate, roughly 20 cm across. It holds about 7-8 strips of cooked bacon, which look crispy.

Cooked crispy bacon is about 40 kcal and 8 g per slice. Some of these strips look thicker, so I'll assume about 9 strips-equivalents at 8-9 g each. That gives about 70 g of bacon and roughly 380 kcal, since bacon runs about 5.4 kcal/g. Crispy bacon may be closer to 4.5-5 kcal/g, which gives about 330 kcal for 70 g.

I'll go with 60 g and 300 kcal.

{"kcal": 300, "mass_g": 60}
